jobs.title: Principal Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Meet Upside:

We created Upside to transform brick-and-mortar commerce. Our technology uses the sophistication of online retail—profit measurement, attribution, and incrementality—to provide users with more value on their everyday purchases and brick-and-mortar businesses with new, profitable customers. We’ve helped millions of users earn 2 to 3 times more cashback than any other product, and hundreds of thousands of brick-and-mortar businesses earn measurable profit. Billions of dollars in commerce run through the Upside platform every year, and that value goes directly back to our retailer partners, the consumers they serve, and important sustainability initiatives.



The impact you'll make

As Upside's Product Marketer focused on Product Commercialization, you will work at the intersection of our Product and Retailer Go-to-market (RGTM) teams to shape how retailers think about our product. Internally, your work will drive cohesion and clarity across teams. Externally, your work will drive both product adoption and top-line revenue growth by acting as the voice of the retailer during product development, and by leading the commercialization of products and feature releases.



Specifically, you will:

 - Champion the voice of the retailer, using market and competitive research to highlight opportunities in the product strategy.

 - Ensure internal alignment by acting as the primary liaison between the Product and Retailer Go to Market (RGTM) teams, to champion the voice of the retailer and align on roadmap priorities

 - Define our internal product GTM hierarchy in order to ensure effective and impactful launches and positive retailer reception

 - Contribute to our pricing strategy so that our price point reflects the product's value, covers costs, and meets retailers’ expectations

 - Drive adoption of new products and features among target prospects, channel partners, and the existing Upside retailer partners

 - Help to discover and document new product use-cases based on retailer pain points that could turn into new solutions and product offerings

 - Partner with Revenue Enablement to ensure the Sales and Accounts teams are equipped to tell the product story and accelerate conversion and expansion opportunities  



What you should have

 - 7+ years of experience in product marketing, sales enablement, or a related role—preferably in B2B, SaaS, or a high-growth tech environment.  Experience with marketplaces is a plus.

 - A proven understanding of product commercialization and experience developing strategies to drive product adoption

 - Outstanding messaging and positioning skills, with the ability to distill complex ideas into clear, compelling value propositions.

 - Proven track record of crafting high-impact sales enablement content—including pitch decks, playbooks, and competitive battle cards.

 - Experience working cross-functionally with sales, marketing, and product teams to align on go-to-market strategies.

 - Demonstrates leadership through influence, earning trust through clear communication, concrete business cases, and compelling storytelling that achieve positive outcomes.

 - Data-driven approach, with experience using insights to optimize sales performance and messaging.

 - A bias for action and results, with the ability to work independently and drive initiatives forward in a fast-paced environment.

 - A genuine passion for problem-solving and applying an analytical approach to each new challenge.

 - Resiliency, by adopting the evolving nature of the position with a willingness to take on new responsibilities as the role continues to develop and expand.
   
   

Location:

This role offers location flexibility, however, if you’re based in the Washington, D.C., Austin, Chicago, or NYC metropolitan regions, in-office attendance is required on a hybrid basis.



Compensation:

The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is $179,000 - $215,000 + equity + benefits. The final starting pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Personalization and MarTech
jobs.description:
Meet Upside:

We created Upside to transform brick-and-mortar commerce. Our technology uses the sophistication of online retail—profit measurement, attribution, and incrementality—to provide users with more value on their everyday purchases and brick-and-mortar businesses with new, profitable customers. We’ve helped millions of users earn 2 to 3 times more cashback than any other product, and hundreds of thousands of brick-and-mortar businesses earn measurable profit. Billions of dollars in commerce run through the Upside platform every year, and that value goes directly back to our retailer partners, the consumers they serve, and important sustainability initiatives.



The Impact You'll Make

Upside is building a sophisticated, personalized engagement system that uses AI, marketing technology, and consumer data to bring users to the Upside app with the right message, creative, and incentive at the right moment to drive the next highest action for the consumer. This is one of Upside's highest-leverage growth opportunities, with the potential to meaningfully grow user acquisition, frequency, retention, and revenue. As the Principal Product Manager owning this space, you'll have the rare chance to build this system largely from the ground up — turning an ambitious, high-level vision into a concrete, sequenced roadmap, and making foundational calls about the systems, partnerships, and technology needed to bring it to life.



What You'll Do

 - Own the strategy and roadmap for building Upside personalized growth engine. Translating a broad, ambitious personalization vision into sequential, buildable phases.

 - Define clear requirements and specs, and prioritize the backlog across the growth stack — data infrastructure, multi-channel outreach, app surface areas, creative personalization, and incentive systems — including build-vs-buy-vs-integrate decisions.

 - Define success metrics and KPIs for the growth system, and use data to guide prioritization and validate impact.

 - Lead efforts to drive multi-vertical (Fuel, Grocery, Restaurant) network adoption, identifying high-relevance users and targeting them with localized, personalized communications based on proximity to relevant retail locations.

 - Run rapid experimentation on messaging and incentives, using results to identify what drives repeatable user habits before scaling successful patterns globally.

 - Build a strong partnership with Upside's internal consumer marketing team, deeply understanding their needs and translating them into clear product requirements.

 - Lead cross-functionally without direct authority, aligning engineering, design, data, and marketing around a shared roadmap and set of priorities.



Competencies You'll Need

 - 10+ years of product management experience, including leading complex, ambiguous, or platform-level initiatives.

 - Proven track record of building scalable personalization platforms, CRM systems, or 0-to-1 products — not just isolated features.

 - Strong quantitative and analytical skills, with hands-on experience using data and experimentation to guide product decisions.

 - Technical fluency and ability to synthesize granular detail into clear, strategic narratives for different audiences — comfort operating at both a high strategic level and a deep analytical level is critical to this role.

 - Exceptional communicator who builds deep cross-functional trust and can influence senior stakeholders without direct authority.

 - Strong business acumen, with the ability to connect product decisions to retention, revenue, and broader company strategy.

 - Deep consumer empathy and an intuitive understanding of what motivates user behavior.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Consumer Product Management
jobs.description:
Meet Upside:

We created Upside to transform brick-and-mortar commerce. Our technology uses the sophistication of online retail—profit measurement, attribution, and incrementality—to provide users with more value on their everyday purchases and brick-and-mortar businesses with new, profitable customers. We’ve helped millions of users earn 2 to 3 times more cashback than any other product, and hundreds of thousands of brick-and-mortar businesses earn measurable profit. Billions of dollars in commerce run through the Upside platform every year, and that value goes directly back to our retailer partners, the consumers they serve, and important sustainability initiatives.



The Impact You'll Make

Upside's consumer app is on a hypergrowth trajectory — scaling from millions of active users toward a much larger, mainstream audience. This role owns the consumer growth system end-to-end: conversion, retention, cross-sell, and organic user-to-user growth. You'll be accountable for the hundreds of product decisions, big and small, that shape how consumers experience Upside every day.



You'll bring a strong point of view on where the consumer growth strategy should go next, grounded in data, consumer insight, and rigorous prioritization. You'll also raise the bar on quality and polish across the app, strengthening the reliability and trust consumers place in the product. And you'll play a key role in growing how consumers use Upside across multiple everyday spend categories — gas, grocery, and restaurants — turning single-category users into multi-category habits. You'll lead a team of consumer product managers and report directly to the CPO.



What you'll do

 - Own the consumer growth system — conversion, retention, cross-sell, and user-to-user growth over paid media

 - Set and evolve consumer growth strategy, grounded in data, consumer insight, and rigorous prioritization

 - Own the product decisions that drive quality, polish, reliability, and trust across the app

 - Drive multi-category adoption — turning single-category users into engaged users across gas, grocery, and restaurant

 - Build habit formation and frequency into the core product; balance supply/demand and unit economics

 - Lead and grow a team of consumer PMs; scale the team with an AI-centric approach

 - Partner with Design, Data, and Marketing to turn consumer insight into measurable product bets



Competencies you'll need

 - Track record owning consumer app growth through a hypergrowth curve, including the full growth system (conversion, retention, cross-sell, organic growth)

 - Strong product judgment — high-quality, high-polish consumer experiences and disciplined prioritization

 - Deep consumer app expertise; secondary marketplace expertise (supply/demand, unit economics)

 - Experience building habit-forming products and driving adoption across multiple use cases or product lines

 - AI-centric approach to scaling product management

 - Experience leading a team of PMs (5-10) and growing PM talent

 - 10+ years PM experience; curious, hungry to grow, bias for progress over perfection



Nice to have's

 - Fintech, marketplace, or transaction-driven product background

 - Experience designing for trust and credibility as a conversion lever

 - Exposure to payments or financial-experience product work



Who this is not for

 - Someone looking for a purely visionary, blank-slate mandate — this role is about scaling and elevating a fast-growing consumer product, with real ownership over strategy within that mandate

 - Someone who prefers managing large, layered organizations over staying close to the product and the team

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Restaurant Vertical
jobs.description:
Meet Upside:

We created Upside to transform brick-and-mortar commerce. Our technology uses the sophistication of online retail—profit measurement, attribution, and incrementality—to provide users with more value on their everyday purchases and brick-and-mortar businesses with new, profitable customers. We’ve helped millions of users earn 2 to 3 times more cashback than any other product, and hundreds of thousands of brick-and-mortar businesses earn measurable profit. Billions of dollars in commerce run through the Upside platform every year, and that value goes directly back to our retailer partners, the consumers they serve, and important sustainability initiatives.



The Impact You'll Make

Upside has established itself in fuel and scaled into grocery. Restaurant is the vertical with the most headroom and the least built — and this role owns it. As the Product Manager for the restaurant vertical, you'll operate like an entrepreneur inside a company that already has distribution, data, and a proven measurement engine: you decide which restaurant segments to win, what the wedge product is, and how the economics have to work for a restaurant operator to see real, provable profit. That means adapting Upside's core incrementality system to restaurant behavior, shaping the offer optimization models that price every promotion, and building the merchant-facing product that turns measured profit into a partner who renews and expands. Few PM roles come with this much ownership over a real business.



What You'll Do

 - Own the strategy and roadmap for Upside's restaurant vertical on the merchant side — segment prioritization, feature requirements, and the path to scale.

 - Adapt Upside's core incrementality and measurement system to restaurant economics, where visit cadence, ticket size, margin structure, and promotion sensitivity all behave differently than fuel or grocery.

 - Partner with data science on restaurant offer optimization — pressure-testing model assumptions, surfacing limitations, and translating model behavior into terms a restaurant operator understands and trusts.

 - Drive transaction and profit growth for restaurant partners, and own the metrics that prove it.

 - Build the merchant-facing product experience that demonstrates value: measurement, reporting, onboarding, and the tools account teams use to make the case.

 - Partner with sales and account management to drive adoption and retention within restaurants, and act as the voice of the restaurant vertical in company-level forums.

 - Make build-vs-buy-vs-integrate calls on the POS, payments, and data integrations the vertical depends on.

 - Set and drive OKRs for the vertical, and lead cross-functionally — engineering, data science, design, sales, accounts, and marketing — without direct authority.



Competencies You'll Need

 - 6+ years of product management experience, including B2B or merchant-facing products in retail, restaurant technology, payments, or ecommerce.

 - Demonstrated 0-to-1 ownership: has built a product line or business area from early stage rather than optimizing a mature one.

 - Strong command of unit economics and measurement — incrementality, attribution, margin math — and the ability to defend a methodology to a skeptical partner.

 - Hands-on experience working with data science or ML teams on models that drive pricing, offer, or targeting decisions.

 - Able to synthesize granular technical and quantitative detail into clear narratives for very different audiences, from an ML engineer to an independent restaurant owner.

 - Exceptional influencing skills; builds deep trust with sales and account teams whose buy-in the vertical depends on.

 - Strong user empathy for small and mid-sized business operators, and the judgment to know which of their requests to build and which to decline.

 - Thrives in ambiguity with a metrics-and-experimentation-driven approach to decisions.
